# smart-saver

Saves, updates and deletes uploaded files to and from the hard disk.

## Installation:

```bash
npm install smart-saver
```

## Usage: 

- Config once a common containing folder for all files (note that on each save/update/delete you can specify a different folder than this one):
```typescript
import { saver } from "smart-saver";
import path from "path";
saver.config(path.join(__dirname, "..", "my-assets", "my-uploaded-files"));
```

- Save an uploaded file:
```typescript
const createdFileName = await saver.save(newUploadedFile);
```

- Update existing file with a new uploaded one:
```typescript
const updatedFileName = await saver.update(existingFileName, newUploadedFile);
```

- Delete existing file:
```typescript
await saver.delete(existingFileName);
```

- Get existing file path:
```typescript
const filePath = saver.getFilePath(existingFileName);
```

- Get a cool file-not-found path:
```typescript
const filePath = saver.getFileNotFoundPath();
```
